heapControl.method: Fresh renderer, official CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage after each group; three catalog types per group.

obsidian.hotReloadCaution: Repeated disable/enable in one renderer retained more than 2 GB after many probe iterations; a full Vault reload reset it. This development reload pattern is separate from the measured steady preview path.

drawnix.fileApi: standard file input/download; File System Access disabled in the isolated browser context
drawnix.limitation: The application reflows mind nodes but arrows retain fixed points. source.id/target.id are semantic metadata; Plait expects boundId handles and its shape binding types do not include MindElement.

circuitikz.coldCache: Initial 30-second runner attempts timed out downloading TeX resources. A separate compiler bootstrap completed; all six acceptance compiles then passed with --only-cached.
circuitikz.compilerWarning: The Windows binary emitted a Fontconfig configuration warning; bundled PDF fonts rendered successfully.
circuitikz.visualReview: Six golden templates and five orientation variants reviewed. NAND/NOR control wires use repeated named nets; untransformed text stays readable beside mirrored devices. Transmission gates use horizontal S/D paths and separate complementary controls. Topology remains unchanged.

powerpoint.reference: Same rendered HTML consumed by the visible native export
powerpoint.limitation: Native font shaping and line metrics remain different from Chromium. Mermaid/SVG geometry remains image fallback; no pixel-identical or fully native reconstruction claim.

retrieval.provenance: Independently authored from the existing implementation fixtures. Queries and relevance labels were frozen before the first evaluation. Synthetic engineering notes, not private user Vault data or an external benchmark.

host.method: Real Vault.read and getFiles timings around the shipped local-knowledge inspect command. Each inspect rebuilds; normal title batches reuse one retriever. Five repeats exercise a warm OS file cache.

retrieval.decision: Preserve immutable per-batch snapshots and lexical retrieval. Do not tune to these labels; use a new validation split before CJK tokenization, stopword/ranking changes, or embeddings.
